item.title: In 1969, a Nevada man built a desert home from junk; today, Thunder Mountain is a free attraction
item.description: Thunder Mountain Monument in Nevada features sculptures created from discarded materials by Frank Van Zant. This unique roadside attraction developed from his personal vision to honor Native American history. After a fire in 1983, the site faced preservation challenges until it was recognized as a historic site in 1992. The monument is maintained today with visitor donations and a caretaker's assistance. item.description: Global Threads research project reveals how slavery hung ‘like a spectre’ over the Peterloo massacre and other Mancunian struggles for equality They were the killings that changed Britain, paving the way for working-class people’s right to vote, as well as leading to the founding of the Manchester Guardian. In the Peterloo massacre of 1819, peaceful protesters were shot and trampled to death by the Manchester and Salford Yeomanry at St Peter’s Field in the city. item.description: Two men died and more than a dozen others were injured Saturday when floats overturned during annual festivals in Osaka Prefecture.
